_README: Host evidence template for the attendance Windows-native exact-SHA QA v2 matrix. Copy this file to <evidence-dir>/summary.json on the Windows host, then fill it ONLY from real synthetic-data execution. The qa-runner validates SAFETY + SHA binding only; it never judges product correctness — you decide PASS/FAIL per case by following the per-case runbook (attendance-windows-native-qa-v2-pqa-cases.md) and comparing observed vs expected. Ships with every case status=BLOCKED and unaffirmed safety fields on purpose: a straight copy without doing the work reports BLOCKED, never PASS.

_fill_instructions.sourceSha: Leave as the pinned SHA; must equal the package SOURCE_SHA (0dc3596dd...). qa-runner BLOCKS any mismatch or stale SHA.
_fill_instructions.residue: Set to the number returned by residue-check.sql AFTER running every case's cleanup. PASS requires 0. Leave null until measured.
_fill_instructions.isolatedDatabase: Set true only after confirming you ran against the isolated QA database, not a shared/customer DB.
_fill_instructions.databaseName: Set to metasheet_windows_qa (the only accepted isolated DB name).
_fill_instructions.windowsPowerShellVersion: Set to your Windows PowerShell 5.1.x version string (e.g. 5.1.19041.4522). PowerShell 7 is not accepted.
_fill_instructions.customerOrExternalDestination: Affirm false — no customer/production/external destination was touched.
_fill_instructions.externalNotificationsSent: Affirm false — no external notification (DingTalk/WeCom/Feishu/webhook/email) left the host.
_fill_instructions.cases[].status: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED. Start BLOCKED. Set PASS only when observed == expected for every step AND that case's cleanup left residue=0. Set FAIL on any product deviation.
_fill_instructions.cases[].syntheticDataOnly: Per-case affirmation that only synthetic orgs/users/shifts/punches were used. PASS requires true.
_fill_instructions.cases[].reason: Short evidence note: what you observed, what you compared against, the residue count for this case.
